about_the_game:
Someone helped you escape from prison, but freedom comes at a price. Now it’s time to repay your debt.

You've been dropped onto a isolated island swarming with zombies. Your mission? Steal whatever valuables remain. If you survive, you go free. If not... well, you knew the risks.

KILL THE ZOMBIES

The city is full of undead, all hungry for fresh flesh. Fight your way through their ranks using firearms, melee weapons, explosives and traps.

OR OUTSMART THEM

Zombies may be plentiful, but they're not the brightest. Find alternate routes, do distractions, sneak past them - and if you make a noise, make sure you're ready to defend yourself.

WORK TOGETHER 

You'll need to work together. Assign roles - who's going to break down doors, who's going to watch your back, and who's going to secure the loot. Think about your equipment, coordinate your actions and make your crew as efficient as possible.

ALL FOR THE MONEY

After the outbreak, the city's residents turned into zombies. They don’t care about money anymore – but you do!

  • Crack safes

  • Rob bank vaults

  • Steal priceless artefacts from museums

  • Discover hidden stashes

Just remember – the bigger the score, the greater the risk.

WHAT AWAITS YOU IN ROB THE DEAD

Dynamic maps - randomised elements ensure that no two heists are ever the same.

Varied Gameplay - triple the bloodbath, operate stealthily, or mix your tactics.

Co-Op & Solo Play - team up with up to 4 players or take on the challenge alone.

Ready to rob the dead?

The MadBus 🚌 awaits!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains intense violence, bloody scenes, and brutality (including decapitation or dismemberment of zombie-like creatures), as well as strong language.

short_description: A co-op horror FPS about daring heists in a city full of zombies. Because, you know, they don't need money anymore, but you do! Multiple ways to approach each heist and randomly generated elements await you. Gather your team and get ready to rob the dead!
